method: Generated by scripts/dev/check_layered_architecture.py --report-only from the committed source tree at the time of approval, then reviewed entry by entry. Entries recorded here are grandfathered: the ratchet permits them and fails closed on anything new. Per-service budgets carry no slack, so removing one violation and adding another is still a failure. Removing an entry is always allowed and is the intended direction of travel.

debt.reason: kit_struct_log uses `from . import struct_log`, which imports the package __init__. That __init__ is `from .extension import *`, so a logging adapter transitively pulls in the Kit extension entry point. This is the same entry-point shape already grandfathered as a module cycle in architecture/observed-baseline.json; breaking it means reworking the extension surface, not relabelling the layer.

structLogBootstrap imports trustedCoordinatorBase from config/env to decide where to ship structured logs, so a shared primitive reaches upward into application configuration. The fix is to inject the coordinator base at the bootstrap call site instead of importing it; that touches console startup, which migrate-console-to-hifi-design currently owns.
